title: Yo-kai Watch 4 (YW4 Recomp)
description: Yo-kai Watch 4++ (Switch, v2.2.0) statically recompiled into native Windows and Linux builds, drawn by its own Vulkan renderer. 60++ fps, widescreen and ultrawide, DLSS and FSR, keyboard and mouse, English patch and mod support. Bring your own dump: no game files or keys included.
